description: The Global LEI Index of the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation holds historical and current records of Legal Entity Identifiers (LEIs), the ISO 17442 identifiers of legal entities that take part in financial transactions. Level 1 data give who is who (such as official name and registered address) and Level 2 data give who owns whom (relationship records and reporting exceptions), in Common Data File formats checked against XML schemas. GLEIF issues three sets of Golden Copy files each day, free of technical duplicates and with enriched reference data, plus four delta files with new or changed LEIs compared with eight hours, one day, seven days and one month earlier; concatenated files from the issuers, an API and mapping files linking LEIs to BIC, ISIN, MIC, OpenCorporates and other identifiers are also offered. Coverage is global. Access is free of charge; the licence text was not found on the pages read. Caveats: LEIs cover only entities that register, and ownership data depend on what entities report. For simulation it provides the entity and ownership network of financial and corporate actors for contagion, counterparty and supply-chain dependency analyses. Related catalogue records include the FDIC BankFind Suite and the BIS locational banking statistics.
